pagedPresenceFor.reason: SW62 replaces each bounded DocumentByID predicate with an independently owned current installed first ID-or-current-slug header containing only literal documentRole inputs. Supplied policy retains its original generation and each document lookup retains its separate current-registry selection. Headers close within each predicate; read failures propagate and the response writer returns 503 for cancellation/admission/coverage failures. The shared roster is cloned before deletion and original presence payloads and order survive filtering. The 520-case warm/reloaded HTTP differential covers the complete existing principal/API-key matrix, document/issue/route filters, explicit/inherited grants, missing records/teams, current/previous slugs and update/removal response paths; direct checks prove shared-roster immutability, cancellation propagation, zero ownership leaks and zero full decodes. Tier A SW64 separately proves header source and admission semantics normally, persistently and under race.
